svg.font-family: Inter, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.text: PatchPilot — human-gated vulnerability triage & remediation
LangGraph state machine · durable interrupts · LangSmith-gated regression suite · guardrails enforced in code
INPUTS

g.text: cached JSON fixtures · zero network · live mode behind a flag

svg.text: passes through injection classifier before any LLM sees it
LangGraph StateGraph · PostgresSaver checkpointer · one thread per (repo, scan_id) · each advisory fans out as a Send() branch
auto_fix: patch bump · no new test failures · non-sensitive package · high confidence
not_applicable · accept_risk — policy-determined, batched into routine update PR, no human needed
reject / defer → ledger only
Routes to human_gate when any of:
major-version bump · EPSS ≥ threshold · package in auth / crypto / serialization tier
newly failing tests after bump · reachability confidence < 0.7 · sandbox unsupported
injection classifier flagged the text · run cost approaching budget
Tools called by plan_remediation
Docker sandbox (Python 3.9+, cached dependency layer) · PyPI version resolver
on-demand changelog vector index, queried by the symbols this repo imports
Output: GitHub pull request on a branch
minimal bump diff · reachability proof · CVSS/EPSS with as-of date
changelog citations · test diff · reviewer identity · LangSmith trace link
GUARDRAILS — enforced in code, wrap every node; a violation halts the run, it never silently continues
Pydantic contracts on all tool I/O · action allowlist: PR on a branch only, never merge / protected branches / CI config / secrets · injection classifier on untrusted text
secret scan before any GitHub write · per-run token & dollar budget hard-stop · deterministic policy veto over any LLM recommendation · every PR links its LangSmith trace

g.text: traces for every run, linked from every PR
golden dataset (versioned): ~60 seeded + ratified live decisions
Prompt Hub: prompts versioned, diffed, and gated like code
CI gate — GitHub Actions on every PR to PatchPilot itself
1. pytest: tools · policy · guardrails · graph (recorded mode)
2. langsmith evaluate over the golden dataset
BLOCK if any golden decision flips · score < baseline · p95 cost > budget
override only via a "golden update" PR with a second human approval

svg.text: resume(decision) → human_gate
DECISION CLASSES

g.text: auto_fix — safe patch bump, no new test failures, PR opened without a human
needs_human — graph suspends at interrupt(); reviewer decides with evidence
accept_risk / not_applicable — policy-determined, recorded with reasons
halted — guardrail violation (schema, budget, allowlist, injection)
Every ratified reviewer decision becomes a golden case.
A flipped golden case blocks merge until a human redefines "correct" in a reviewed PR.
Deterministic demo: fixture repo patchpilot-demo-app, ~10 pinned vulnerable deps, recorded API responses.
Stack: Python 3.12 · LangGraph · LangChain · LangSmith · Postgres · Docker · FastAPI · pytest · GitHub Actions
